name: junan-pickle-exchange
reviewNotes: All 19 original glyph records reviewed, including winter-only sales, deposit prompts, both exchange branches and full-inventory responses.
Use existing item names: white radish, pickled radish and senmaizuke. Preserve eight radishes per pickled radish, sixteen per senmaizuke, and the 64-radish storage limit.
Keep dynamic quantity and character fields, duplicate balance notices and every source newline; record 5 is an open quantity-entry prompt. No exchange mechanics are changed.
